# Discord Social SDK

This directory contains the release redistributables from Discord Social SDK
1.10.19337, imported from `DiscordSocialSdk-1.10.19337.zip`.

MAMEHub uses application ID `1545444437482676284`.  Desktop authentication
uses the SDK's public-client PKCE flow and requires this redirect URL in the
Discord developer portal:

    http://127.0.0.1/callback

Only the public headers, notices, and desktop release libraries are vendored.
Debug libraries and the optional Krisp voice assets are intentionally omitted.
